day: Day 1: Travel to Amritsar & Golden Temple Visit
activities: Morning: Take an early morning train or flight from Delhi to Amritsar (5–6 hours by train, 1.5 hours by flight).
Afternoon: Check into your hotel and have lunch at a local Punjabi restaurant.
Evening: Visit the iconic Golden Temple and experience the serene evening prayer ceremony.
Night: Enjoy langar (community meal) at the temple or dine at a nearby dhaba.

day: Day 2: Jallianwala Bagh, Partition Museum & Wagah Border
activities: Morning: Visit Jallianwala Bagh and learn about its historical significance.
Late Morning: Explore the Partition Museum for an emotional insight into India’s past.
Afternoon: Lunch and relax, then head to the Wagah Border for the Beating Retreat Ceremony (by 3 PM).
Evening: Witness the patriotic flag-lowering ceremony between India and Pakistan.
Night: Return to the city and explore Amritsar’s street food scene.

day: Day 3: Local Markets & Return to Delhi
activities: Morning: Visit Durgiana Temple and Ram Bagh Gardens.
Late Morning: Shop for phulkari, juttis, and Amritsari spices in Hall Bazaar or Katra Jaimal Singh.
Afternoon: Check out from your hotel and head back to Delhi by train or flight.
Evening: Arrive in Delhi with memories of a soulful trip.
